All Impinj Tags.Description: This section contains the overridable common features and bits supported by all chips

Password Killable.Description: When the kill bit is set to 1 while the kill password is provided the tag will no longer respond over the air

Password Lockable.Description: When the lock and/or permalock bits are set while the access password is provided, the tag will not allow the memory to change

EPC Permalockable.Description: This tag allows for the EPC to be permanently locked

EPC AFI Bits Writable.Description: There is NVM in the PC Word

BlockWrite.Description: Enables 32-bit BlockWrites which significantly improves write performance

Untraceable Short Range.Description: Decreases a tag’s read range by >90% via the EPCglobal Gen2v2 Untraceable command

FastID.Description: Enables 2x to 3x faster EPC+TID inventory for authentication and other TID - based applications

TagFocus.Description: Suppresses previously read tags to enable capture of more tags

Integra TID Even Parity Check.Description: All tag chips with Integra have TID serial numbers with even parity. If the TID serial number for a tag is found to have odd parity, it indicates potential physical damage to the tag and hence questionable integrity of the data inside it

Integra Memory Self Check.Description: Include automatic word - wise parity checking for all memory spaces.Automatic parity checking prevents tags from sending corrupt data to a reader during Gen2v2 inventory rounds or read operations

Integra MarginRead.Description: This feature allows a reader to explicitly verify that each bit of the tag chip NVM is strongly written and has sufficient charge margin for reliable operation. It is used for tag quality control to ensure data integrity and for failure analysis

QT.Description: Through QT technology, a tag owner/user can maintain two data profiles (one public, one private), allowing confidentiality of business - sensitive data while assuring consumers of privacy.The tag owner stores confidential data in the private data profile, which is protected by a password-controlled command and may only be accessed at very short read distances

Protected Mode.Description: enables loss prevention while protecting consumer privacy by making a RAIN tag invisible to RAIN readers.The tag can be returned to normal operation, and made visible to RAIN readers, using a secure PIN

Enhanced Integra Automatic Memory Parity.Description: Suite of diagnostics verify tag chip health and validate data encoding to consistently deliver more accurate data and reliable tags

Short Range Capability.Description: Adds a layer of physical security by preventing readers farther than roughly one meter from the tag from switching the tag from Public to Private(or vice versa)

AutoTune.Description: Automatically adjusts performance to optimize readability for environment and application

I2C Interface.Description: Use a synchronous, multi-master, multi-slave, packet switched, single-ended, serial computer bus communication protocol with this end point

Id.Description: The Model Number of the Tag used for matching the value representing this Tag Chip

Range.Description: Bit range of the TID memory Bank

XTID Indicator (X bit).Description: XTID indicator bit. A value of 1 to indicate the presence of an extended TID

Security Indicator (S bit).Description: When set to 1 it means the tag implements the Authenticate or Challenge commands

File Indicator (F bit).Description: When set to 1 it means the tag implements the File Open command

Mask Designer Identifier (MDID).Description: GS1-assigned 9-bit Manufacturer Identifier (MDID) for Impinj is 0000000012 and is located in TID memory bit locations 0Bh - 13h

CRC-16.Description: The cyclic redundancy check (CRC) is a technique used to detect errors in digital data. CRC16 is a 16-bit word hash function that detects accidental changes to the tag memory

EPC Length.Description: The word length of the EPC

Reserved for Future Use, or Application.Description: Reserved for Future Use or Application Family Identifier

EPC.Description: The EPC field of the EPC Memory Bank

Range.Description: Bit range of the EPC Memory Bank

Kill Password.Description: Killing a tag requires a non-zero kill password to be applied

Access Password.Description: Locking a tag requires a non-zero access password to be applied

Range.Description: Bit range of the Reserved Memory Bank

BlockPermalock Enabled.Description: Dictates whether BlockPermalock is available on those chips with the BlockPermalock Feature

Kill Password Locked.Description: Kill Password is prevented from being written to if set to 1, 0 otherwise.

Kill Password Permalocked.Description: Kill Password locked or unlocked state is permanent if set to 1, 0 otherwise

Access Password Locked.Description: Access Password is prevented from being written to if set to 1, 0 otherwise.

Access Password Permalocked.Description: Access Password locked or unlocked state is permanent if set to 1, 0 otherwise

EPC Locked.Description: EPC is prevented from being written to if set to 1, 0 otherwise.

EPC Permalocked.Description: EPC locked or unlocked state is permanent if set to 1, 0 otherwise

User Memory Locked.Description: User Memory is prevented from being written to if set to 1, 0 otherwise.

User Memory Permalocked.Description: User Memory locked or unlocked state is permanent if set to 1, 0 otherwise

Killed.Description: Prevents the tag from transmitting if set to 1, 0 otherwise

BlockPermalock 0.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 0 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 1.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 1 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 2.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 2 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 3.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 3 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 4.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 4 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 5.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 5 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 6.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 6 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 7.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 7 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 8.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 8 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 9.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 9 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 10.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 10 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 11.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 11 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 12.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 12 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 13.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 13 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 14.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 14 is permanently locked

BlockPermalock 15.Description: Bit that dictates if Block 15 is permanently locked

Range.Description: Bit range of the User memory Bank

Impinj Monza X-2K.Description: Impinj Monza X Dura tag chips bring intelligent, embedded RAIN RFID to electronic devices for data logging, device configuration and upgrades, and IoT sensor applications with 2K bits of Memory

Impinj Monza X-8K.Description: Impinj Monza X Dura tag chips bring intelligent, embedded RAIN RFID to electronic devices for data logging, device configuration and upgrades, and IoT sensor applications with 8K bits of Memory

Impinj Monza 4D.Description: Provides 128 bits of EPC memory, 32 bits of User memory, and a serialized TID. For applications where large memory is not required, Monza 4D offers superior sensitivity, True3D antenna support and a unique TID within a more standard memory size

Impinj Monza 4E.Description: Offers up to 496 bits of EPC memory, 128 bits of User memory, and a serialized TID to provide fast access to a larger memory, as well as meet the needs of applications requiring greater than 96 bit EPC numbers.Monza 4E also provides True3D antenna support

Impinj Monza 4QT.Description: Offers 512 bits of user memory, 128 bits of EPC memory, BlockPermalock capability, a serialized TID, and True3D antenna support. The extended User memory options support applications where users cannot count on a database connection. The 512 bits of User memory enables a portable, but private database to travel with the tag.Monza 4QT also provides Impinj’s patent-pending QT technology, which protects data confidentiality and consumer privacy

Impinj Monza 4i.Description: Ideal for component-level tagging in vehicle and production line manufacturing, Monza 4i tag chips are built with an extended EPC memory to track long serial numbers along with a large amount of user memory to chronicle the production process and components from raw material through final assembly

Impinj Monza 5.Description: Ideal solution for item-level tagging of apparel, electronics, cosmetics, and jewelry, or any other application that requires high - volume, high - performance, serial - numbered tags

Impinj Monza R6.Description: This UHF RFID tag chip is optimized for serializing items such as apparel, electronics, cosmetics, documents and jewelry. It delivers unmatched read performance and data integrity for effective RFID business systems and record-breaking encoding performance to enable the lowest applied tag cost

Impinj Monza R6-P.Description: Impinj Monza R6-P RAIN RFID tag chips attach to everyday items, enabling retail applications like global inventory tracking, brand protection and loss prevention

Impinj Monza R6-A.Description: This RAIN RFID endpoint IC (or tag chip) is optimized for serializing items such as apparel, electronics, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, jewelry and various other products where enhanced privacy protections such as short range mode and Kill and Access commands are preferred

Impinj Monza R6-B.Description: Provides excellent high speed performance in challenging airport RF environments

Impinj M750.Description: With 96 Bits of EPC and 32 bits of User Memory it can be attached to or embedded in nearly any item, globally, to enable solutions for high - speed inventory counting, loss prevention with frictionless self - checkout, and embedded tagging with seamless product returns

Impinj M730.Description: With 128 Bits of EPC it can be attached to or embedded in nearly any item, globally, to enable solutions for high - speed inventory counting, loss prevention with frictionless self - checkout, and embedded tagging with seamless product returns
